expectations: Electron GUI, host audio, MPV and MPRIS remain out of scope for the initial container
The host runtime and VS Code Dev Containers extension remain user-provided prerequisites
context: CONTRIBUTING.md: tested Node.js and pnpm versions and development commands
package.json: pinned package manager and project quality/build scripts
docs/agents/architecture.md: web and remote build surfaces

FR-001.title: The development container MUST provide Node.js 23.11.0 and pnpm 11.5.2, matching the versions documented for Feishin development.

FR-002.title: The development container MUST install dependencies using the committed pnpm lockfile without modifying it.

FR-003.title: The development container MUST keep node_modules in a container-managed volume, separate from the host workspace.

FR-004.title: Contributors MUST be able to run the project typecheck, lint, web build, and remote development workflows from the container.

FR-005.title: The initial development container MUST NOT claim to provide Electron GUI, host audio, MPV, MPRIS, or other desktop host integration.

FR-006.title: Setup instructions MUST identify the required host container runtime and explain how to open the repository in the container.

intent: Provide an isolated, reproducible Feishin development toolchain without changing host tools or other workspaces.

decisions.decision: Use the official Node Dev Container feature to pin Node.js and pnpm.
decisions.why: It supplies the project-tested versions inside the container and avoids changing host tools.
decisions.rejected: Use host Corepack or a system-wide pnpm installation.

decisions.decision: Store node_modules in a named container volume and omit desktop GUI/audio integration from the first version.
decisions.why: This keeps dependencies away from the host workspace and avoids platform-specific Electron integration scope.
decisions.rejected: Bind-mount dependencies onto the host or claim full desktop parity.

specify.summary: Specified an isolated Node/pnpm Dev Container for build and browser workflows.
specify.key_finding: The repository documents Node 23.11.0 and pnpm 11.5.2 as its tested stack.

approach: Use the official Dev Container Node feature for the repo-pinned Node.js and pnpm versions, isolate node_modules in a named container volume, install from the frozen lockfile, and document supported workflows and desktop limitations.

T001.did: Added the pinned Dev Container and verified its JSON syntax.

T002.did: Documented container startup, supported workflows, and desktop-specific exclusions.

T003.did: Added the development-container spec to the living-spec index.

T004.did: Validated Dev Container config, pinned tools, isolated volumes, install, lint/typecheck, web and remote builds, and remote HTTP response.

verified.what: Pinned toolchain, isolated volumes, frozen install
verified.command: npm exec --yes --package=@devcontainers/cli -- devcontainer exec --workspace-folder . sh -lc 'test "$(node --version)" = v23.11.0 && test "$(pnpm --version)" = 11.5.2 && test "$(pnpm store path)" = /pnpm/store/v11 && test -w node_modules && test -w /pnpm/store && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && git diff --quiet -- pnpm-lock.yaml'
npm exec --yes --package=@devcontainers/cli -- devcontainer exec --workspace-folder . pnpm run lint

verified.what: Web production build with 4 GB heap
verified.command: npm exec --yes --package=@devcontainers/cli -- devcontainer exec --workspace-folder . sh -lc 'NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 pnpm run build:web >/dev/null 2>&1'
npm exec --yes --package=@devcontainers/cli -- devcontainer exec --workspace-folder . pnpm run build:remote >/dev/null 2>&1

npm exec --yes --package=@devcontainers/cli -- devcontainer exec --workspace-folder . node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:5173').then(response => { process.exit(response.ok ? 0 : 1); }).catch(() => process.exit(1));"
